error_definition: Per-rollout mean fingertip distance over the final 30 steps; quantiles across all 500 rollouts, including failures.
success_definition: Mean <10 mm and maximum <20 mm over both final-30 and final-100 windows.
timing_definition: Total online computation pooled across steps 6--300; separate sessions.
caveat: Paired repeated evaluation on seeds 10001--10500; not a new untouched test set. p=8, K=64, rank=53, T_sim=300, atlas, weights and reset seeds are fixed. Guidance includes chordal waypoints and iterative N=10 terminal selection; the unguided policy uses a fixed nearest eligible terminal configuration. This isolates that policy package, not waypoints alone. Timings come from separate sessions.
